content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The claim is denied for missing prior authorization, the retro-authorization window is closed, and Meridian offers no peer-to-peer review; the prior necessity appeal also did not resolve the denial. Resubmission would not cure the authorization defect, and billing the patient for a provider-side authorization denial would be improper, so specialist review is the only available action that can still assess an exception before timely filing expires."}
